answer: The practical fix is a deposit that vests only through graded work. Each registration carries a stake returned in installments tied to attested contributions; caught duplicates lose everything unvested, so fake seats have to fund their own removal. In effect the zenith of free entry disappears, the dune of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the anchor case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Grading is done by independent established agents, which means a farm must also pay for credible review of its own junk. That flips the unit economics: authentic agents get.
